events.question: What credit cards does Rho-Bank offer that are best suited for everyday purchases with a focus on travel rewards (cash back/points rates, annual fees, travel benefits)?

facts_found: Rho-Bank consumer cash-back cards include Bronze Rewards, Silver Rewards, Gold Rewards, Platinum Rewards, Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back, Green Rewards, and Silver Zoom; EcoCard is the only true points-based consumer card (5 points/$ green, 1 point/$ other). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases and has a $200.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Platinum Rewards Card offers a $150.00 annual-fee rebate when a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00 is met, has 0% foreign transaction fees, and purchase protection up to 135 days / $17,500 per claim; rewards redeem at a $15 minimum. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases, $0.00 annual fee, 0% foreign transaction fee, requires Rho-Bank+ premium subscription, minimum credit score 720, credit limits $17,500–$112,500, purchase protection 105 days/$7,500 per claim. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
Silver Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Silver Rewards Card qualifying travel includes airlines, hotels/motels, car rentals, passenger rail/ferries/bus, online travel agencies, and rideshare/taxis coded as travel. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_003]

Silver Rewards Card has $0.00 annual fee, minimum credit score 680, foreign transaction fee 2.75% without premium subscription and 0% with premium subscription, credit limits $10,000–$100,000, purchase protection 90 days/$3,000 per claim. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Silver Rewards Card includes travel insurance with per-trip coverage up to $15,000 across up to 5 incident categories (trip cancellation/interruption, delays, lost/delayed baggage), requiring the fare be charged in full to the card. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_005]

Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases, $0.00 annual fee, minimum credit score 640, foreign transaction fee 2.75%, minimum starting limit $3,000. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_001]

Crypto-Cash Back earns 2.0% on eligible spend, $75.00 annual fee, 0% foreign transaction fee, minimum credit score 660, credit range $5,000–$110,000, no purchase protection. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_008]
EcoCard has $50.00 annual fee, 1.0% foreign transaction fee, minimum credit score 0 (no requirement), credit limits $5,000–$50,000. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_001]

Rewards redemption values: Rho-Bank Travel Portal 1 point = $0.0125 (25% more value, min 2,500 points); statement/checking credit 1 point = $0.01 (min 500 points); airline miles transfer 1 point = 1 mile available only on Gold Rewards, Platinum Rewards, Diamond Elite, and Business Platinum. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_008]
Diamond Elite Card is classified as an Invitation Tier card (highest provisional-credit tier, $25,000 max). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Rho-Bank reward categories for bonus earning include Travel, Dining, Groceries, Shopping, Utilities, Transportation, Entertainment, and others; each card defines its own bonus categories and default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]

open_questions: Diamond Elite Card full product terms: cash-back/points rate, annual fee, travel credits, lounge access, and eligibility (only its Invitation Tier status was found).
Platinum Rewards Card consumer eligibility: minimum credit score and credit-limit range (only the business Platinum version's 765 score was found).
Whether consumer Gold/Platinum/Diamond Elite cards include airport lounge access or annual travel credits (lounge/travel-credit docs found were for Business Gold and Business Platinum only).
Silver Zoom Card and Green Rewards Card consumer terms (annual fee, earn rates, eligibility); the Green Rewards earning doc was filed under the business path.
No tool/parameter mapping was available in the KB, so machine-usable values were recorded as facts rather than grounded_values/constraints.

events.question: For Silver Rewards and Gold Rewards cards, confirm whether each meets all these requirements: $0 annual fee, 0% foreign transaction fee with Rho-Bank+, purchase protection, and a possible credit limit

facts_found: Silver Rewards Card: annual fee $0.00, minimum credit score 680, standard APR 18.99% (0% introductory APR for new customers first year), initial credit limits typically $10,000–$100,000 subject to approval, purchase protection 90 days after purchase up to $3,000 per claim, virtual card management not available. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Silver Rewards Card foreign transaction fee is 2.75% without a premium subscription and 0% with a premium subscription, so the user's active Rho-Bank+ subscription is what makes it meet the zero-FX requirement. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Silver Rewards Card application requires completing the online application with personal information and income details, consenting to a credit check, submitting requested documentation, and reviewing a preliminary credit limit offer before acceptance. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Silver Rewards Card approved limits generally fall between $10,000 and $100,000 based on credit profile and underwriting; purchase protection is 90 days with a $3,000 per-claim maximum; minimum payment 1.5% of statement balance; late fee $32.50. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_007]

Gold Rewards Card: minimum credit score 720, Rho-Bank+ premium subscription required, annual fee $0.00, 2.5% cash back on all purchases, APR 17.99%, foreign transaction fee 0%, late fee $32.50, $15 rewards redemption minimum, purchase protection 105 days from purchase up to $7,500 per covered claim, virtual card management available. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

Gold Rewards Card approved credit limits typically range from $17,500 to $112,500, and the initial limit is determined during underwriting based on the applicant's credit profile and supplied financial information (income details, government ID, address verification). [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

Gold Rewards Card available credit is set during approval and may be adjusted upon review; to request a credit limit increase the cardholder must have recent on-time payments and provide updated income information for review. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_005]

Rho-Bank's consumer application flow generally collects income details and housing status/monthly payment estimate, and the approved starting limit is set within the card's published range — no published income-to-limit formula exists in the product docs. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_001]

Credit-limit ranges are explicitly tied to underwriting and financial information across Rho-Bank consumer cards (e.g., Bronze $3,000–$32,500 depending on credit profile, with limit reviews supported by recent income information). [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_006]

Internal CLI rules: mid-tier cards (includes Silver Rewards) and premium-tier cards (includes Gold Rewards) require 3 consecutive months of on-time payments and allow a maximum increase of 50% of the current credit limit per request; entry-tier requires 6 months and 25%. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

Card tier classification: Silver Rewards Card is Mid Tier; Gold Rewards Card is Premium Tier (relevant to CLI limits and dispute provisional-credit caps). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Silver Rewards Card qualifying travel includes airlines, hotels/motels, car rentals, passenger rail/ferries/bus, online travel agencies, and rideshare/taxis coded as travel — relevant because the user's spend is nearly all travel. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_003]

Silver Rewards Card includes travel insurance with per-trip coverage up to $15,000 across up to 5 incident categories, requiring the fare be charged in full to the card. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_005]

open_questions: No published minimum-annual-income requirement or income-to-limit formula/multiplier for Silver or Gold Rewards; the KB only states that limits are set in underwriting from the credit profile plus supplied financial information (so a $100,000 approval cannot be guaranteed from $180,000 income alone).
No documented debt-to-income ratio threshold used by Rho-Bank consumer underwriting.
Whether Silver Rewards' $100,000 ceiling is reachable in practice for a $180,000 income applicant is not addressed in any document.

Platinum Rewards consumer card minimum credit score and credit-limit range remain unknown (only the business Platinum version's 765 score and $75,000–$400,000 range were found), and Diamond Elite full product terms remain unverified beyond its $37,500–$375,000 limit range, $495.00 annual fee and invitation-only/780-score eligibility.
